📖 How to use

  1. Type your meta description.
  2. Watch the character count (target 120–160) and the estimated pixel width (desktop cuts ~920px).
  3. Check the Google-style SERP preview to see exactly what searchers would read.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How long should a meta description be?

120–160 characters is the safe zone. Google truncates by pixel width (~920px on desktop), not characters — wide letters like "W" eat more space.

How is pixel width estimated?

Each character is measured against average glyph widths at Google's result font size. It is an estimate, but it predicts truncation far better than char count alone.

Does the meta description affect rankings?

Not directly — but a compelling, complete description raises click-through rate, which is worth real traffic.
